description: This file defines the DateFormatter class responsible for converting Excel date/time format masks to PHP date format masks. It includes mappings for various date components and methods for formatting date values according to specified formats.

classes.name: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Style\NumberFormat\DateFormatter
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to convert Excel date/time format masks into PHP date format masks and format date values accordingly.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a given value into a date string based on the provided Excel date/time format mask.
